cards.notes: Online-only application. No 0% intro — but its 13.8% standard APR is Ireland's lowest, so it can work out cheaper than cards that revert to ~22.9% once a 0% period ends.
0% on purchases for 9 months (Ireland's longest purchase intro). Money transfers 5.9% for 24 months. Instalment plan from 8.6% APR on purchases over €250.

cards.balanceTransferOffer: 3.83% (variable) on purchases & balance transfers for first 12 months from account opening, then reverts to standard rate. Balance transfers from store cards or non-AIB cards only; capped at €5,000.
cards.notes: Minimum €40k salary. Cash back 0.5% on annual spend €5k–€50k (max €225/yr). Up to 56 days interest-free if cleared in full.

cards.balanceTransferOffer: 0% on balance transfers & purchases for up to 6 months (must meet minimum monthly payments).
cards.notes: App-only, near-instant decision. Limit up to €10,000. RevPoints rewards. Cash-advance APR 19.99%.

cards.balanceTransferOffer: 0% on balance transfers for 7 months or 0% on purchases for 6 months (new customers choose one), then reverts to standard rate.
2.9% (fixed) on balance transfers for 12 months. No intro purchase offer. Then reverts to standard rate.
0% on balance transfers for 7 months or 0% on purchases for 6 months (new customers choose one), then reverts to standard rate.
0% on balance transfers for 6 months, plus 0% on purchases for 3 months, then reverts to standard rate. One balance transfer per card.
0% on balance transfers for 7 months or 0% on purchases for 6 months (new customers choose one), then reverts to standard rate. Annual fee billed as €6.50/month.
